summary: Add staged, on-device renewal for saved iPhone profiles and a local device-renewal staging command.

replay.detail: No existing history is rewritten or rebuilt.

schema.detail: Adds renewal stage, challenge and completion records within the existing client pairing namespace, using native client operation receipts.

compatibility.detail: Adds client renewal routes and the devices renew-stage command. Existing manual pairing remains available. On-device approval requires an iOS build with the updated native key module; older builds do not offer this flow.

downtime.detail: No startup migration or scheduled downtime.

manual.detail: An operator stages a replacement for an existing profile; the phone presents its member, person and scopes for approval. The previous saved profile remains unchanged until replacement is verified and saved.

recovery.detail: Uncompleted stages expire automatically. A failed approval retains the previous saved phone profile; a fresh stage can be created if needed.
